deliveryContract.capability: Repair the existing business-notes panel's Plugin-scoped font parity, panel-width-responsive layout, and native help-dialog positioning without changing behavior or composition.
deliveryContract.placement: The already selected and mounted business-notes panel instance in its current Layout; no relocation, recreation, or remount.
deliveryContract.lifecycle: CSS-only extension of the existing business-notes Plugin; preserve its registration, mounted instance, locale, dialog interaction semantics, Escape handling, and focus restoration.
reusedComponents: Project Button
Input
Card from the existing design-system exports

arguments.desiredOutcome: Fix only the approved Plugin's remaining real-browser styling defects: match the Host's Inter,system-ui,sans-serif typography locally; prevent English header/help-trigger and input layout from overflowing or clipping at the actual panel width, including narrow panels on a wide viewport; and locally center and constrain the native modal dialog within the viewport. Do not modify behavior, locale, Runtime, framework, vendor, Composer, Sidebar, Host page, or base CSS; do not create or remount a Plugin.
missingCapabilities: The existing Plugin does not enforce Host typography for its controls and dialog.
Responsive styling is keyed to viewport width and does not wrap/shrink correctly at the actual panel width.
The native dialog lacks explicit local centering and viewport bounds when Host base styles reset its UA margin.
reuseEvidenceRefs: business-notes existing Plugin source at /src/agent-ui/plugins/business-notes/index.tsx and /src/agent-ui/plugins/business-notes/styles.css was inspected; it already uses project Button, Input, and Card and owns the dialog behavior.
arguments.uiScope: Existing Host UI selection is the project-owned design-system Button/Input/Card imported by /src/App.tsx and by the Plugin. /src/design-system/system.css defines the Host's Inter,system-ui,sans-serif font and acme control styles. App.tsx loads that stylesheet around AgentMount. Keep those public controls and copy their font convention only in Plugin-scoped CSS. Do not add Ant Design or AgentUI controls: Ant Design is not used for this mounted form, and no new dependency or Provider change is in/
arguments.dataScope: No data, state, service, or Runtime changes; styles only.
excludedOperations: No new Plugin identity or files
No AppUIModel or composition changes; preserve current registered mounted instance
No Runtime, framework, vendor, Composer, Sidebar, Host page, or base design-system CSS edits
No behavior, locale, or dependency changes
